items.prompt: The CSV header is wrong. Which behavior matches this project specification?

options.text: Return an empty accepted dataset and pretend it loaded
options.why: That hides a batch-level schema failure.

options.text: Fail the whole load visibly with an exception
options.why: Header failure prevents the boundary from interpreting records.

options.text: Guess the columns by whichever numbers look plausible
Reject only the first data record and continue with later records
options.why: The header is checked before data records are interpreted. A wrong header fails the load rather than becoming one rejected data record.

items.explanation: Batch-level parsing/schema failures do not become a successful zero-row report. The caller must surface the failed load.
